cohort: A single infant diagnosed prenatally with vein of Galen malformation, who was followed up to 5.5 years of age, and their mother.
finding: Prenatal diagnosis using Power Doppler imaging and early neonatal endovascular treatment are important for preventing heart failure and mortality in Vein of Galen malformation.
mod_finding: The infant was delivered by elective caesarean section at 39 weeks gestation.
